rationale: The 8.8 aggregate Premier Triage and Response row lists Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The detailed Cloud workflow requires Platform 10.2+, ES 8.7+, enabled assistant, paired SOAR, an eligible existing finding, burst and daily limits and connector/action/asset permissions and frontier model guidance. The 8.7 guide retains historical naming. The detailed CMP prerequisites list Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0. The exact release notes now show November 4 GA; the mapped historical CA section and exact CMP setup URL could not be verified. Edition and regional sections remain scoped; exact pairing, per-agent rollout, entitlement and authorization are excluded.

exclusions: CMP has its separate Platform 10.4+/ES 8.8+/Cloud Connect 2.0 chain; no lower-floor eligibility, tenant rollout, entitlement, pairing or authorization is established.
